rp.text: Hi, I’m Flex, a little muscle fibre. I’ll swim along with you here.
Isla loves it when I move. One short walk after a meal and I pull sugar out of your blood for her.
I can feel 4 sugar crumbs hiding in this world’s corners. Steer Misty right up to one and she gobbles it.
